title: The it-ops-kb-docs submit_feedback block hook does not parse in PowerShell, so it does not block without Git Bash
goal: The it-ops-kb-docs plugin's PreToolUse hook on submit_feedback exits 2 with its message on stderr in every shell a command hook can reach (sh, Git Bash and PowerShell on Windows without Git Bash), so the call is blocked on every host; a test runs the command in each shell present

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/it-ops-kb-docs/.claude-plugin/plugin.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(1 if any('>&2' in x.get('command','') for e in h for x in e['hooks']) else 0)

notes: Found by BG-rcwroffk: the command `echo '...' >&2; exit 2` runs in PowerShell when Git Bash is absent (kb/public/claude/hooks.md, shell form), where `>&2` is a parser error (MissingFileSpecification): powershell.exe 5.1 exits 1, a non-blocking hook error, so submit_feedback goes through. Reproduced with powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command on Windows 11.

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/it-ops-kb-docs/.claude-plugin/plugin.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(1 if any('>&2' in x.get('command','') for e in h for x in e['hooks']) else 0)
